Verbose Logging
Writes a detailed log to Documents. Enable before reporting a bug.
Log to Screen
Also posts short phase messages to the in-game message log, in addition to the summary shown after every use.
Smelt Stamina Share
The share of each smith's crafting stamina spent on smelting; the remainder is left for refining.
Recover Stamina While Travelling
When enabled, heroes in your own party also recover crafting stamina while travelling between settlements, not just inside one. Never affects AI-controlled parties.
Travel Recovery Rate
Multiplier on the travelling recovery rate. 1.0 means travelling recovers crafting stamina at exactly the same rate as resting in a settlement.
Evaluation Budget
Soft cap on how many candidate weapon designs the advisor evaluates per search. Higher values can find a marginally better design at the cost of a longer search.
Search Time Budget
Hard wall-clock cap, in milliseconds, on one 'Suggest best' search. When it trips, the search stops immediately and returns the best design found so far.
On Foot Damage Weight
How much a design's effective damage counts towards its on-foot score. A tuning value, not a game rule.
On Foot Attack Speed Weight
How much attack speed counts towards the on-foot score. A tuning value, not a game rule.
On Foot Reach Weight
How much reach counts towards the on-foot score. A tuning value, not a game rule.
On Foot Handling Weight
